stone: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create the NORTH-SOUTH / VERTICAL orientation sprite of exactly the SAME stone bridge in the reference. Keep its construction, colors, low railings, short posts and hand-painted friendly fantasy game art. Camera is fixed above and slightly from the SOUTH/front, not rotated with bridge. Rotate the BRIDGE on the GROUND PLANE 90 degrees, so the walking path runs straight from image TOP to image BOTTOM, centered. Parallel left and right edges in orthographic projection; absolutely no diagonal bridge axis. The deck paving/planks follows this structure but preserves the global elevated oblique camera. Because camera stays fixed, the long vertical sides' outward faces are largely hidden and the decking is more visible; do NOT fake it by rotating the flat reference image. Show subtle thickness and supports at the near bottom end, low rails down both sides. Full bridge with margins, portrait orientation, isolated on actual transparent alpha including any openings. Consistent light from upper left and subtle lower-right shadow. No surroundings, water, terrain, bank, text, UI, characters or tall decorations. One complete bridge, not a sheet. This is the same universal bridge variant for a 2D board game, only its ground direction changes.
